CAP. 252] Belize Copyright
4
CHAPTER 252
77 of 2000. COPYRIGHT ACT (COMMENCEMENT) ORDER
[26th August, 2000.]
Short title. 1. This Order may be cited as the
COPYRIGHT ACT (COMMENCEMENT) ORDER.
Commencement of 2. In exercise of the powers conferred upon me by section 2 of the
Act No. 12 of 2000. Copyright Act (No. 12 of 2000), and all other powers thereunto me enabling,
I, GODFREY SMITH, Attorney General, do hereby appoint the 21st day
of August, 2000 as the day on which the said Act shall come into force.
MADE this 21st day of August, 2000.
(GODFREY SMITH)
Attorney General
